subject.title: Guard Skill Workshop update applies against delta drafts

question: Should Skill Workshop update apply fail closed on the PR's proposal-note heuristics, accepting possible false-positive rejection of unusual but complete skills?
rationale: Source and proof establish the destructive-write bug, but code inspection cannot determine the repository's preferred balance between preventing data loss and preserving permissive update compatibility.

options.title: Sponsor the guarded rejection
options.body: Accept the tested marker policy as a first-layer safety guard after the max-lines repair and normal required checks pass.

options.title: Require an explicit replacement contract
options.body: Pause this implementation and require proposal creation to persist a canonical full-replacement artifact with revision binding rather than infer intent from Markdown phrases.

options.title: Keep permissive apply behavior
options.body: Decline fail-closed content-shape validation and continue relying on approval, rollback, and user review despite the demonstrated destructive-write footgun.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the guarded rejection
recommendation.body: Accept the tested marker policy as a first-layer safety guard after the max-lines repair and normal required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history owns the central proposal apply/write and rollback lifecycle where this compatibility decision belongs.
